precepts.text: Truth shall spring out of the earth. Opening the Bible is how the lies are swallowed up.
precepts.point: Having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience when your obedience is fulfilled. Brothers want to be on the Saturday night specials casting out demons in the street, but you cannot revenge disobedience until there is no impediment to sin left in your own spirit, your household, and your children.

note.label: The Divine Orchestration and Purpose of the People You Encounter

precepts.why:
“For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds”. You are at war right now in your spirit, with evil temptations pushed on every front: family members, school, work, even your own thoughts as you sit here. The weapons are not guns; the weapons are the commandments of God, and they are mighty.

Mighty to pull down what? Lies. That is what the Bible does; that is how we tear the lies down. We open up the Bible and swallow up the lies, like it says in the Psalms: “Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.” We open this Bible, and the lies are swallowed up.

So “Casting down imaginations” is casting down lies, “and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God”, and the knowledge of God is the law, the Bible. When you open this Bible and apply the commandments, you get rid of those impulsive, sinful thoughts and bring every thought “into captivity” under the obedience of Christ. That is how you walk straight past your temptation.

precepts.why:
The weapons of our warfare are the commandments. You are supposed to answer your impulses, your sinful temptations, with the commandments of God, and that is supposed to turn you from the door of temptation. If you understood that death is around the corner, you would listen to these laws.

But the wicked man thinks judgment is far off: “Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.” Because the judgment is not immediate, his sick, evil mind is emboldened to commit evil and sin, and he leaves the commandments to the side. You had better recognize where you are.

That is the war inside you. The Lord isn't asking you to pick up a gun and go do something out there; he is asking you to get your mind right and set this mark in your head to change your behavior. We don't advocate anyone initiating aggression; if someone comes at you with a rope or a knife, you defend yourself. But the gung-ho brothers who can't wait for war can't even discipline their food. The war to win first is against the heart that sin makes bold.

precepts.text: Now therefore set thine house in order, and reprove thy people. Your house cannot be in order while your head is not. Check your own thoughts and temptations before correcting your wife, son, or daughter; then your obedience is fulfilled and you can revenge disobedience.

precepts.why:
“And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.” Some of our people can't wait: they want to be part of the war in the streets, casting out demons, getting their names on the Saturday night specials: brother, get a good angle of me, I want my video to go up Saturday. But here's the stipulation: when your obedience is fulfilled. That means there is no impediment left in your spirit to commit sin; you are walking straight in your spirit, your household, with your children, blameless. Then you can go out and correct your people.

That is what the Apocrypha says: “Now therefore set thine house in order, and reprove thy people”. First set your house in order. Your physical house can't be set in order if your spiritual house, meaning your damn head, is not in order. You haven't even checked your own wicked thoughts, your own actions, your own temptations, and you are trying to correct your wife, your son and your daughter.

Set your head in order; then you can set your house in order; then you can reprove your people. That is when your obedience is fulfilled, and you can revenge all disobedience, because you checked it first within yourself. We want to play warrior, to look good, while there are demons all up in us that we have not corrected yet.

note.label: Destroyed by Familiar Hands

precepts.why:
Our fathers in the wilderness “did all eat the same spiritual meat”, “And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.” What sustained Israel was spiritual, and it was Christ. “But with many of them God was not well pleased”.

That is why Paul says “For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh”. We walk in the physical, but we do not war after the physical. This is spiritual warfare. “For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds”. Our job is “Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God”, casting down every evil imagination in the mind of our people, “and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ”, the black Messiah.

So get your mind right and get your mind together, so you can prepare for the second coming of Christ. No matter what happens in this place, do not get caught up in foolishness. If they can treat a white woman like that in Minnesota, imagine how they can treat us. Do not go out there talking about helping march. This is not your problem. Stay in the scripture.

Even your own family in the world, who tell you they hate the Most High, will call and pull you into their stupidity: that's my brother, that's my mama. Do not get caught up. Our job is to get our people ready for the second coming.

note.label: Deuteronomy 20: Laws of Warfare and the Spirit of Fear

precepts.why:
What kind of battle is Israel in now? “For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)”.

We are not physically out battling the nations as our forefathers were when they took the land; we are in a spiritual battle. The strongholds are the doctrines, lusts, and wicked thoughts in the minds of our people, and they are fought with the scriptures, the sword of truth.

The nations are confederate against Israel being a nation any more, and this whole world is set up for our people to go into sin and iniquity. So the horses and chariots and the people more than thou are met today with weapons mighty through God, not carnal ones, and the word is the same: be not afraid of them.

note.label: Judges 3: Nations Left to Prove Israel

precepts.why:
For those who do not think we are at war now: “though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh.” It is a spiritual war, but we are still nonetheless at war.

“For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds.” The weapon of our warfare today is this Bible, mighty through God, “Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ”, exposing all the lies on the earth.

Othniel went out to war with the sword and the Lord delivered Chushan-rishathaim into his hand. We go out to war with the word, and it is the same Lord, the man of war, who gives the victory.

precepts.point: With thee he breaks in pieces man and woman, old and young, the young man and the maid, the shepherd and his flock, the husbandman and his oxen, and the captains and rulers. The sisters who love feminism had better humble down, because the woman is named right alongside the man.

note.label: Jeremiah 51: The Full Recompense of Babylon

precepts.why:
“(For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)” Our weapons are not carnal. We take up no army, for our fight is spiritual, and the Most High fights for us when we keep the commandments.

So when he says “Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms”, it is not Israel raising a carnal army. It is the Most High doing the breaking, mighty through God, with a people who keep his commandments. With that he breaks in pieces the horse and his rider, the chariot and his rider, man and woman, old and young, and captains and rulers.

“Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God,” This is read so you brothers can see what we are facing. This is not going to be a walk in the park; nobody goes to war thinking it is a walk in the park; there are going to be casualties, and this is spiritual warfare, not knives and guns. You are at war to wake up your people, to change the mind of the black man in America and all over the world, to save the soul of our people. Esau, the enemy, is not going to take it lying down after spending billions of dollars over 400 years to keep you stupid; now you are waking up, they are coming after you, making up laws and making up things so they can come after you. That is the type of war you are in.

Casting down imaginations: you might imagine Jesus Christ is white; as leaders we have to cast that down. You might imagine the Sabbath is in the morning; we have to cast that garbage down. You might imagine I'm going to eat fish for Passover, buy a box of Popeyes chicken; we have to cast that down. As leaders that is your job, and it is not over yet: there is going to be a lot more doctrine come, as Paul said those things must come to pass, and it is going to be brothers and sisters sitting right next to you. Some of you think you are in la-la land and everything is going to be fine; your trial and tribulation is coming. Remember us in Egypt: we became so low we started to serve an animal as a god, an animal you can kill. It is the same thing in America: God says lamb, the brother says chicken; God says goat, the brother says chicken. That dude said you don't have to do the Day of Atonement; the Day of Atonement, is that good or bad? It's good for you, so why tell me not to do it? They don't want you to see the light, and you follow because you move by emotion and feeling, not by laws: he's a good teacher, I love the brother. The brother is a damn ashy black devil; that is what he is going to die like. When you are caught up in your feelings and emotion, what happens next? Death. The holy days mean days separated from other days, each with its own spirit; a foolish man tells you to change what you do on the holy days and you don't see the devil coming for you. Don't come to the feast days, the Passover, the new moon with a sad face; get up and do a little dance for the Lord. Sister, you are going to die with depression.

This right here is your job description; this is why we have been sent here. Sisters too: you have to cast these imaginations down in here as well. A lot of times you see the brother or sister next to you starting to malfunction and you say nothing, because you are non-confrontational, you don't want to ruffle feathers, you want someone else to do it. No: that is a symptom, he's tripping, and you could have stopped it right there: hey bro, that ain't what the scripture is talking about. It takes believing brothers and sisters to stop the nonsense in its tracks. There was a flat earth situation: people who were in the Navy, who travelled around the world and didn't fall off the side, now think the earth is flat; they say we teleported. Because you don't want to be that person, that nonsense grows and festers, and now two or three people in here think the earth might be flat. The point is not the earth being flat; it is the demonic spirit that comes with that doctrine. Froward thoughts separate from God (Wisdom of Solomon 1:3): when you hear things separating from the Bible, unbiblical, stomp it right in its tracks; be that backbone. If you don't check it you will see the spirit leaving that person slowly, and next thing they are eating pancakes and bacon and eggs for the Passover. You are watchmen; your job description is right there in 2 Corinthians 10:5: cast down any nonsense that comes out, throw it to the ground violently, not literally. Don't play with it; not for an hour; we are not going to sit and argue with you. When you catch cancer early you have a better chance, but you let these brothers get to stage four. Be responsible. Walk outside, look up at the moon and ask him about that curvature; he'll say I'll get back to you and go Google some stuff. A good understanding have all they that do his commandments. When we witness evil in our presence and don't immediately stomp it out, it sends a message that the gospel we hold is not worth fighting for; that small piece of leaven, that small seed of evil, will destroy everything we are building. Let us take heed to the gospel we have been taught, lest at any time we let it slip (Hebrews 2:1). Like on your job: the minute you do anything against the company's policies you are dealt with immediately, because they see that small infraction as a detriment to the whole company. That is the seriousness in making sure things stay on course.
